continuum_initial_maximum.method: nested tensor-grid refinement of the closed-form E-29 Cartesian vorticity magnitude sqrt((r u1_z)^2 + (2 u1 + r u1_r)^2) with an analytic axial derivative; the window shrinks to two cells on either side of the discrete argmax at every stage

convergence_fit_precondition_definition: there exists at least one (snapshot label, audited field) whose complete resolution ladder satisfies fit_precondition at every resolution audited; see fit_precondition_ladders
description: P0-D core-width audit of the already-saved Hou early-time snapshots, plus the P1-B amplification renormalization. The two audited evidence bundles supply four distinct radial resolutions (65, 129, 193 from hou_early_time_v1 and 129, 257 from hou_early_time_v2_hires); the shared 129x256 ladder rung is checked for byte identity and audited once. Every snapshot label written by those runs is audited, from t000 (the E-29 initial datum) through t004 (T_1 = 0.002191729). Both the stored swirl u1 and the pointwise magnitude of the E-18b Cartesian vorticity rebuilt from (u1, omega1) are measured, because the amplification numbers are built from the vorticity, which is one derivative rougher than u1. The preregistered minimum points per front is deliberately NOT restated here: ns_certificate_lab.core_width.PREREGISTERED_MIN_POINTS_PER_FRONT is the single source of truth and the summary records it from the module.
interpretation: This is a read-only measurement of how many grid points resolve the narrowest structure the saved arrays contain. Every count is a property of the sampled array and bounds what the grid can represent; none of them is a statement about the continuum solution, and nothing here is evidence for or against singularity formation. The fit_precondition verdicts can only forbid convergence fits; they never certify one, and Hou published values are never fit targets.
limitations: Every points-per-scale count is a property of the SAMPLED ARRAY.  It bounds what the grid can represent; it is not a statement about the continuum solution, and a large count is not a certificate of accuracy.

The high-frequency tail fractions are computed from single snapshots on finite grids.  Aliasing folds unrepresented continuum content back into the represented modes, so a small tail fraction is consistent with badly under-resolved data; only a large one is informative, and then only as a warning.

The gradient length scale is built from three-point differences, which are least accurate exactly where the length scale is smallest, and its minimum is frequently attained at the edge of the active region rather than at the narrowest feature.  It is recorded, not gated on.

The common-grid differences compare two unconverged discrete solutions restricted onto the coarser mesh.  They include the restriction error of the Catmull-Rom operator and are not error estimates; no convergence order is fitted from them in this experiment.
The 129x256 resolution appears in both audited bundles.  The audit checks that the two copies are byte identical and then audits one of them; it does not treat them as independent samples.

fit_precondition can only forbid a convergence fit.  Passing it removes a preregistered prohibition; it never validates a fit, and it says nothing about time discretization, boundary treatment or the elliptic solve.
Binary64 floating-point arithmetic with tolerances only.  There is no interval enclosure and nothing here is evidence for or against singularity formation.

method.amplification: P1-B: both normalizations are reported side by side for every resolution, the grid-normalized one with a resolution dependent denominator and the common-reference one with the single continuum value below
method.common_grid: ns_certificate_lab.core_width.interpolate_to_common_grid restricts the finer field onto the coarser grid with a separable Catmull-Rom cubic; the coarse field passes through the same code path, where it is the identity
method.continuum_reference: computed in code from the closed form 24000*pi*37^(-1/2)*(36/37)^18; its (r,z) location is located numerically by nested grid refinement of the closed-form E-29 datum, not quoted
method.ladder_rule: a convergence fit is a statement about a resolution SERIES at one time for one quantity, so ladder_satisfied is the conjunction of the gate over every resolution in that series; one resolution passing on its own cannot license a fit
method.reports: ns_certificate_lab.core_width.peak_resolution_report applied to the stored u1 array and to the pointwise magnitude of the E-18b Cartesian vorticity rebuilt from (u1, omega1)

preregistration.source: ns_certificate_lab.core_width; the threshold was fixed by manufactured tanh fronts before any Hou snapshot was measured and is not restated in this experiment's config
